Ella (docs): Heads-up: found a bunch of schema edge cases in function/tool calling docs. Need explicit examples for mixed-type arrays and optional fields in structured output. Can we quick-sync on who's picking which snippet? PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/492
Mike R (eng): Saw that — the model sometimes returns [null, "str", { ... }]. We should recommend a canonical parsing pattern and a fallback example with try/catch. I can paste a small Node snippet.
Jonah (devex): @Ella I'll take TS SDK snippet + unit test example. ETA today.
Sarah L (eng-ml): We also hit a regression in evals when schema had additionalProperties=true — outputs dropped fields. Putting repro log here:
```json
{"promptId":42,"response":{"items":[null,"a",{"kind":"ok"}]}}
```
Ella (docs): Thanks. For docs, want both 'strict schema' and 'lenient parse' examples. Also add a short note on 'how to handle versioned schemas when rolling out model variants'.
Mike R (eng): Node snippet: ```js
try {
  const parsed = JSON.parse(raw);
  // prefer shape validation
  if (!Array.isArray(parsed.items)) throw new Error('not array');
  parsed.items = parsed.items.map(x => x ?? null);
}
catch (e) { /* fallback: pass through raw string and log */ }
```
Jonah (devex): I'll add TS SDK util: `parseStructuredOutput<T>(res: string): T | null` and a test with mixed array. Link to branch when ready.
Ella (docs): Can someone add a short Python example too? readers are half py.
Sarah L (eng-ml): I can add a python snippet and also attach the failing eval test case. Also propose a guardrail: prefer `additionalProperties:false` in new schemas, but document migration path.
Jonah (devex): pushed branch `devex/parse-helpers` — https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/210 — includes TS helper + tests.
Ella (docs): Awesome. I'll update the PR description and add a 'migration checklist' section: version bump, add parsing util, add eval test, add note in release notes. Anyone object to landing both docs and SDK at same time?
Mike R (eng): :thumbsup: No objections. Just add a note about runtime cost if we do deep validation in hot paths.
Sarah L (eng-ml): Agree. Add a 'fast path' example using schema-lite (check top-level types only). I'll draft.
Ella (docs): Great. I'll split the docs PR into two commits: examples + migration checklist, guardrail note in another. Ping me when branches land so I can link.
Jonah (devex): :white_check_mark: will do. Tagging @release-council when PRs are ready.
Mike R (eng): One more thing: include a tiny curl command showing function call response envelope: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate -d '{...}'`
Ella (docs): Added that to the TODO. Thanks all. Closing sync — if anything blocks, drop here.
